Title: Azure Kubernetes Service on Azure Stack HCI now in public preview

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) on Azure Stack HCI simplifies the Kubernetes cluster deployment on Azure Stack HCI. It offers a consistent and familiar Azure experience with built-in security. It’s hybrid design enables customers to use Azure services such as Azure Monitor to manage on-premises Kubernetes clusters. Customers can now consistently and easily deploy their modern applications anywhere - cloud, on-premises and edge.

Get started with the preview and learn more.
